source: Our team has been working on the new billing system for the past six months. The goal was to make invoices easier to read and to give customers a clear view of what they are paying for each month. During the rewrite we replaced a single large table with a set of smaller ones, which made the queries faster and the code far easier to test. Early feedback from support has been encouraging, and we expect the first customers to move over before the end of the quarter. As always, the migration is reversible, and the old system will stay available in read-only mode for at least another month.
note: 多句长段落，检查有没有被截断

source:
The API reference is generated from the source code, so it never drifts out of date. Every change lands in the same pull request as the docs you are reading now.

If a request returns 429, back off for the number of seconds in the Retry-After header. Repeated 429 responses usually mean the key is being shared by more than one client.
note: 两段 + HTTP 状态码
